front: Worked: working-space depth — 480Y/277 V panel with grounded metal on the opposite wall; 208Y/120 V panel facing another live panel
back:
The table uses voltage TO GROUND
480Y/277 V (277 V to ground → 151–600 V row): Condition 1 = 3 ft · Condition 2 (grounded parts opposite) = 3½ ft · Condition 3 (live parts both sides) = 4 ft → 3½ ft
208Y/120 V or 120/240 V (≤ 150 V to ground): 3 ft in every condition → 3 ft
Width ≥ 30 in or the equipment width; height ≥ 6½ ft; doors must open 90°

front: Worked: terminal temperature — 90 °C THHN on a 60 A circuit with breaker marked 60/75 °C
back:
Circuits ≤ 100 A or 14–1 AWG: use the 60 °C column unless equipment is listed and marked for 75 °C (110.14(C)(1)(a))
Breaker marked 60/75 °C → 75 °C column: 6 AWG THHN = 65 A ✔ (90 °C 75 A can be used only for derating math)
Over 100 A or > 1 AWG: 75 °C column (110.14(C)(1)(b))

front: Reading a Code question — words that change the answer
back:
'shall' = mandatory; 'shall be permitted' = allowed; Informational Note = advisory only (90.5)
'Readily accessible' = quickly, no tools/ladders/locks (keys are OK); 'accessible (wiring)' = not permanently closed in
'In sight' = visible and ≤ 50 ft
'Dwelling unit' vs 'one-family dwelling' — a duplex is two dwelling units
'Ampacity' = continuous current without exceeding temp rating

Indoor: footprint of the equipment extended from the floor to 6 ft above the equipment or to the structural ceiling; no foreign systems (ducts, pipes) in that zone (110.26(E)(1)(a))
Sprinklers allowed if the space is protected; dripping protection required over the equipment
Outdoor: same 6 ft; equipment enclosures suitable for the conditions
Working space (110.26(A)) and dedicated space are two different requirements

Covers premises wiring, yards, carnivals, industrial substations, PV, EV... (90.2(A)); NOT utility-controlled installations, ships, mines, railway rolling stock (90.2(B))
AHJ interprets rules, approves equipment, grants special permission (90.4)
Listed equipment: internal wiring not re-inspected at install (90.7)
Maryland: PSI tests the NEC 2020 edition — verify the version on your test notice
